problems.name: Model outputs reasoning text instead of SQL when hint contains complex logic or multiple sub-questions, causing syntax errors.

attempts.what: Update system_prompt.md to strictly enforce returning only the SQL code block and no other text. This addresses failures where the model explains its thought process (e.g., 'To answer...') which breaks execution.
